segment.description: Indian Creek in Claiborne County, Tennessee — the 62.5 sq mi Powell River tributary that TWRA spring-stocks with rainbow trout ('TWRA spring-stocked Clinch River tributary. Small, warm-summer water; best March-May' per catalog; hydrologically it drains to the Powell River arm of the Clinch/Norris system). Distinct from Indian Creek near Tate Springs in Grainger County (USGS 03528030, HUC 06010205).
segment.boundaries: Full named length per catalog. TDEC monitoring points span the lower creek: TDECWR_WQX-TNW000003182 (36.5579,-83.6064, near the Powell River confluence — TDEC also lists 'Powell River ... near confl. Indian Cr.' station POWEL067.8CL) and TNW000003202/TNW000003203 near Greers Chapel (36.586-36.588,-83.603-83.608). USGS 03531900 'INDIAN CREEK AT GREERS CHAPEL, TN' (HUC 06010206, Claiborne Co.) anchors the upper station. Temperature record cited is from the lower-creek station TNW000003182.

coldSource.notes: No dam, spring, elevation, gradient, or canopy documentation found on agency pages. Valley-floor Powell Valley creek (station elevations not published in WQP); the catalog's own 'warm-summer water' note is corroborated by the measured record below.

holdover.detail: No holdover evidence found. Documented program is five spring Seasonal stockings (Feb 15, Mar 1, Mar 15, Mar 29, Apr 12, 2026; Rainbow Trout) with no delayed-harvest or warm-season rows — no program mechanism documenting carry-over past spring.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout record found. Indian Creek (Claiborne) is not on the TWRA Trout Management Plan 2017-2027 wild trout waters list (plan text searched), and the plan describes hatchery-supported streams as 'primarily warmwater habitats that cannot support trout year round'.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: TDEC grab samples on lower Indian Creek (station TNW000003182, 2014-2025) ran 18.5-23.56 C across Jun-Sep — warm-summer water at the edge of trout tolerance — matching TWRA's five-date Feb-Apr put-and-take program design and the catalog's own 'warm-summer water' note.
